profile.description: 100 independent closed-loop clients evenly distributed across 10 Agents; each task uses model/tool/model, with real SQLite and all production audits. Warmup is reported separately. No percentile substitute for the per-task maximum.

environment.measurement: monotonic outer servlet Filter entry to final async onComplete; subtract only min(observed external sleep, configured external sleep); transport, framework, queue, DB and audit remain included; HTTP client roundtrip also retained

continuity.interpretation: Independent wall/monotonic comparison; excludes post-load SQLite verification time. Does not remove any task samples or durations.

stageInterpretation: Inclusive nested spans are not additive; worstSamples.exclusiveMillis partitions each request and sums exactly to its ingress-included bound. External oversleep stays internal.
limitations: Controlled loopback external model/tool services, no real model/Mem0/MCP/notification acceptance.
Production Boot/HTTP/SQLite and controlled driver share one JVM; not a packaged-JAR or isolated server benchmark.
Original maximum threshold remains 50ms. Additional ingress bound includes client/transport overhead and is conservative.
No T102 or later work; no commit or push.
